Name: Better Mixed Seeds
Author: Sonozuki
Description:
[size=5][b][color=#ff0000]ABANDONED[/color][/b][/size][size=3]
See alternatives: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22311/]Re-Mixed Seeds[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22495]Seed Overhaul[/url]

This mod simply changes what seeds can be found using the mixed seeds, meaning you can get any seed from in the game (season dependent and config dependent)[/size]

Better Mixed Seeds supports any mod that adds crops using Json Assets

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Configuration[/size]
[list]
[*]PercentDropChanceForMixedSeedsWhenNotFiber: The percent chance that mixed seeds will be dropped from weeds when fiber isn't dropped
[*]Each seed can be enabled / disabled individually (If all of a season's seeds are disabled, the code will use Stardew's default for mixed seeds, for the season). As well as a chance set to it.
[/list]
[size=5]Extra info[/size][list]
[*]To uninstall delete Stardew Valley/Mods/BetterMixedSeeds.
[/list]
